141487310.title: File:W. A. R. Goodwin and John D. Rockefeller Jr., 1926.jpg

ImageDescription.value: W. A. R. Goodwin (left) and John D. Rockefeller Jr. behind the George Wythe House in Williamsburg, Virginia, on November 29, 1926. Goodwin was the Church of England minister at Bruton Parish in Williamsburg and promoted both the parish and city as important historic locales. Rockefeller funded the restoration of the city as Colonial Williamsburg. The Colonial Williamsburg restoration program was headquartered in the George Wythe House.
